patches.purpose: Use VOID_TYPE_P for typedef void returns and indirect function signatures.
Match actual host widths in labels, i64 constants, relocation addends, sizes and memory offsets.
Add opt-in SIMD128 machine modes and GCC RTL instruction patterns; disabled by default.
Match Basic C ABI singleton/empty aggregate arguments/results and narrow scalar extension.
Emit the five-argument external libatomic compare-exchange ABI without changing the builtin declaration.
Add SIMD scalar-count shifts, signed/unsigned and IEEE comparisons, conditional selection and fixed constant shuffles.
Use direct v128 values for enabled vectors and singleton aggregates; preserve vector register modes and aggregate storage.
Implement IEEE binary128 long double storage, soft-float operations and WASI two-i64 argument/indirect-result ABI independently of SIMD.
Enable signed/unsigned int128, WASI paired arguments/indirect results, scalar bitwise complement and SI runtime shift counts.
Ignore ABI-empty C++ records consistently during layout and generic O0 parameter setup without reading absent incoming data.
Use declared type alignment/storage units for named bitfields and classify singleton ABI values with the original declared storage type; preserve packed and unnamed-field rules.
Ignore unnamed bitfields when classifying singleton ABI values, preserve raw storage offsets, and retain empty aggregate storage modes without emitting an unused hard return local.
